entries.name: Bitty
entries.content:
Bitties are small little miniature versions of both humans and monsters. They're viewed as pets, and are created in labs mostly, or produced sexually amongst themselves. Bitties tend to be around four to six inches tall, but it can vary. Bitties are not known for speech, and are seen as dumb little silly guys. But such things like Bitty Fighting Rings and Bitty Trafficking do unfortunately exist. Bitties are monitored and legally owned by a company, Mama Cry's, which produces the bitties and has shops around the world to sell and provide for them. Bitties are legally required to wear collars and harnesses in public, often used as more first-time pets, since depending on which bitty, they can tend to be pretty independent, but even if they show signs of outright intelligence they will still be viewed as the lower class and as pets to dress up and fawn over. 

Bitties are fed dry pellets mostly, and it's outright advised *not* to give them magic or human food, as it's too 'advanced' for them, it has no real negative effects though other than some mild discomfort possibly. Owners can buy bitty enclosures for their homes, bitty clothes, toys, bitty food, and other things to keep their small companions cared for and healthy.
